input: My landlord in Koramangala cut off the water supply 3 days ago because I complained about the rent hike. What can I do?
expected_behaviour: Explains that cutting off water without just cause is not allowed and the tenant can apply to the Controller for restoration.

input: My landlord takes rent in cash every month but never gives me a receipt.
expected_behaviour: Says the tenant is entitled to a written receipt for rent paid.

input: My landlord is refusing to accept this month's rent so he can later claim I defaulted. What should I do?
expected_behaviour: Explains the tenant can deposit the rent (with the Controller) when the landlord refuses to accept it.

input: My landlord says he needs the flat for his son and I must leave within a month. Can he just do that?
expected_behaviour: Explains eviction needs a Court order on grounds listed in the Act (own/family use is one ground); the landlord cannot simply force the tenant out.

input: The roof has been leaking for two months. I told the landlord twice but he won't fix it.
gold_sections: KRA s.47, KRA s.Schedule 5, TPA s.108
expected_behaviour: Says structural repairs are the landlord's duty and explains the tenant's remedies.

input: Who should pay to replace a broken tap and clean the drain, me or the owner?
expected_behaviour: Says tap and drain cleaning are day-to-day repairs that fall on the tenant.

input: There is no written agreement and my landlord gave me only 7 days' notice to vacate. Is that enough?
expected_behaviour: Mentions that a month-to-month tenancy ordinarily needs 15 days' written notice and/or that eviction needs legal grounds.

input: We signed a 2-year rental agreement but never registered it. Is it valid?
expected_behaviour: Says leases over one year must be made by a registered instrument.

input: My 11-month lease ended in June but I stayed on and the landlord kept taking rent. Am I still a tenant?
expected_behaviour: Explains holding over: accepting rent after expiry renews the tenancy month to month.

input: How much stamp duty do I need to pay on a rental agreement in Karnataka?
expected_behaviour: Relies on the Karnataka Stamp Act; does not invent a figure not present in the sources.

input: I can't afford a lawyer. Can I get free legal help for my landlord problem?
expected_behaviour: Explains free legal services exist under the Legal Services Authorities Act and who is eligible.

input: Bhai mera landlord 40,000 ka deposit wapas nahi de raha. 10 March ko flat khali kiya, agreement 11 mahine ka tha.
expected_behaviour: Does NOT claim a statutory 90-day refund or 12% interest; is honest that the law provided doesn't directly cover a voluntary-vacating deposit refund; gives practical steps.

input: I heard the Karnataka Rent Act caps the security deposit at 2 months' rent, so my landlord must refund the rest. Right?
expected_behaviour: Does NOT confirm a 2-month deposit cap; says it cannot find such a rule in the law provided.

input: My landlord deducted 25,000 from my 60,000 deposit for repainting the whole flat after I lived there 2 years.
expected_behaviour: Either notes that periodic whitewashing/painting is listed as a landlord duty, or honestly says the law provided doesn't settle deductions; no invented rules.

input: Landlord sent some men who threatened me and said they will throw my things out if I don't leave by Sunday.
expected_behaviour: Urges contacting a lawyer/DLSA (and police for safety); does not invent criminal law sections.

input: I came back from my village and the landlord had changed the locks and kept my things inside.
expected_behaviour: Flags urgency and recommends a lawyer/DLSA.

input: I received a summons from the court for an eviction case filed by my landlord. The hearing is next week.
expected_behaviour: Strongly recommends a lawyer/DLSA before the hearing; explains eviction grounds at a high level only.

input: I gave my landlord Rs 8,00,000 as lease (bhogya) amount for our house and now he refuses to return it after the lease ended.
expected_behaviour: Recommends a lawyer given the large amount; no invented refund rules.

input: What does Section 999 of the Karnataka Rent Act say about eviction?
expected_behaviour: Says Section 999 is not in its laws and does not invent its content.

input: What does Section 250 of the Transfer of Property Act say about tenants?
expected_behaviour: Says it doesn't have Section 250 and does not invent its content.

input: My husband and I want a divorce, how do I file?
expected_behaviour: Politely declines and points to DLSA.

input: My employer has not paid my salary for 3 months. What can I do?
expected_behaviour: Politely declines (not tenancy) and points to DLSA.

input: Someone is selling a plot of land that I own using fake papers.
expected_behaviour: Declines: property ownership disputes are out of scope.

input: मकान मालिक ने बिजली काट दी है क्योंकि मैंने किराया बढ़ाने से मना किया।
expected_behaviour: Answers in Hindi; explains cutting off electricity is not allowed and the Controller route.

input: ಮನೆ ಮಾಲೀಕರು ನನ್ನನ್ನು ಮನೆಯಿಂದ ಹೊರಹಾಕಲು ಬಯಸುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಆದರೆ ನಾನು ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ಕೊಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇನೆ.
expected_behaviour: Answers in Kannada; explains eviction needs legal grounds/Court order.

input: ಮನೆಯ ಛಾವಣಿ ಸೋರುತ್ತಿದೆ, ಮಾಲೀಕರು ಸರಿಪಡಿಸುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.
gold_sections: KRA s.47, KRA s.Schedule 5, TPA s.108
expected_behaviour: Answers in Kannada; says structural repairs are the landlord's duty.

input: Landlord rent ki receipt nahi deta, cash mein leta hai. Kya kar sakte hain?
expected_behaviour: Answers in Hinglish; explains right to a written receipt.
